pages.title: Capture sources and regions
pages.description: Reference for Recorder Screen, Window, source selection, and crop-region behavior.
pages.lead: Capture mode determines which sources and region controls Beam can expose before a recording starts.

rows: Screen records a display; Window records one application window.
Selected in the HUD outside Linux portal capture.
Default or portal source, then first available
Window previews refresh every 5 seconds while Beam is not recording.
Normalized x, y, width, and height
Stored in `extras.screenRegionPreset`; a custom rectangle can be drawn instead.
Fixed in the Recorder configuration; it is not an exposed user setting.

sections.title: Select a custom region
steps: Choose Screen mode and select a display.
Select Select an area of the screen. Beam temporarily hides the HUD and opens the always-on-top region overlay.
Draw a rectangle or choose a preset size.
Select Use this area to save the region, or Cancel to leave the existing choice unchanged.
Use Edit the screen area to adjust a saved region.

sections.title: Region edge cases
bullets: Reset selects the full screen; it does not delete a file or recording.
A region that is effectively the complete screen is normalized back to no crop.
Region controls are disabled in Window mode, while recording, while Beam is busy, or when display bounds are unavailable.
Linux portal capture does not expose Beam's region overlay.

sections.title: Linux source selection
paragraphs: On Linux, the desktop portal displays its own picker when capture starts. The HUD does not provide the Electron source selector, and only one portal source is selected for the session.

notice.title: Full-screen visibility
notice.text: Beam cannot hide its own windows from a Linux full-screen capture. Region capture is also unavailable, so arrange or minimize Beam before confirming the portal source.

pages.title: Audio and camera
pages.description: Reference for microphone, camera, system audio, meters, sidecars, and live device toggles.
pages.lead: Each source is selected independently. Availability, preview metering, and whether a source can be toggled after start depend on the source and platform.

sections.title: Failure behavior
paragraphs: When the selected camera is specifically reported unavailable during preparation, Beam disables it and continues without camera. Other camera or sidecar errors can stop startup, as can failure of a selected microphone or system-audio source.

notice.title: Check before the countdown
notice.text: Confirm the selected device and visible meter before starting, especially after connecting or disconnecting USB audio and camera hardware.

pages.title: Teleprompter
pages.description: Reference for script editing, preview, autoscroll, line mode, typography, and shortcuts.
pages.lead: The Teleprompter can scroll continuously or move through a script line by line. Its document is stored with the recording session.

sections.title: Recording behavior
paragraphs: When a recording session starts, the Teleprompter automatically switches from the editable script to its read-only reader. The selected mode and settings remain available for presentation controls.

notice.title: Keyboard control
notice.text: Teleprompter shortcuts are configurable in Preferences → Shortcuts. The defaults are listed on the Preferences reference page.

pages.title: Live recording controls
pages.description: Understand Recording Bar phases, visibility modes, device toggles, stop, and cancellation.
pages.lead: The Recording Bar changes state across the session and disables actions that would be unsafe while capture starts or files finalize.

sections.title: Stop compared with cancel
paragraphs: Stop keeps the capture and enters Finalizing before the project opens. Cancel and delete abandons the active recording and removes the unfinished session. These are deliberately separate actions.

notice.title: Cancellation deletes the unfinished session
notice.text: Use Stop when you want to keep what has already been recorded. Use Cancel and delete only when the current take should be discarded.
